# Bolex Collector

> > Comprehensive resource for vintage Paillard Bolex 8mm and 16mm movie cameras, projectors, and Swiss-manufactured cine lenses

Bolex Collector is a dedicated enthusiast site documenting classic Bolex cinematography equipment including H16, H8, and L8 camera models, along with detailed references for Kern-Paillard, SOM Berthiot, Hugo Meyer, Angenieux, and other vintage lens manufacturers. The site serves as both a historical archive and practical guide for collectors and filmmakers working with Swiss-made film equipment.

## Key Topics

- Paillard Bolex cameras
- Kern-Paillard lenses
- 16mm film cameras
- 8mm film cameras
- SOM Berthiot optics
- Hugo Meyer lenses
- Angenieux lenses
- H16 and H-16 RX models
- Vintage cine lenses
- Swiss film manufacturing
- Classic cinematography equipment
- Bolex movie projectors
- Goerz and Wollensak lenses
- Film equipment collecting
- Historical camera timelines
